# MuPDF.js

> MuPDF.js is the official JavaScript/TypeScript binding for MuPDF from Artifex Software. Powered by WebAssembly (WASM), it enables browser-side PDF processing, Node.js server-side manipulation, and cross-platform document handling anywhere JavaScript runs.

MuPDF.js supports document loading, page rendering, text extraction, annotations, and full PDF manipulation. It is available under AGPL v3 (open source) or a commercial license from Artifex.

- NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mupdf  
- GitHub: https://github.com/ArtifexSoftware/mupdf.js  
- Discord: https://artifex.com/discord/artifex

---

## Getting Started

### Installation (NPM)

Install via NPM:

```bash
npm install mupdf
```

Or with yarn / pnpm:

```bash
yarn add mupdf
pnpm add mupdf
```

The package includes the WebAssembly binary and TypeScript definitions. No `@types` package is needed.

Verify installation with a test file `test.mjs`:

```js
import mupdf from "mupdf";
console.log(mupdf);
```

Run: `node test.mjs` — this prints the mupdf object if installed correctly.

### Supported Environments

- **Node.js:** 14+ (recommended: 18+)
- **Bun:** Full support
- **Deno:** With npm compatibility
- **Browsers:** Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge (all modern versions)

The module is ESM-only: use `import` syntax, not `require()`.

### Using TypeScript

TypeScript definitions are included out of the box:

```ts
import mupdf from "mupdf";
import type { Document, Page, Pixmap } from "mupdf";

const doc: Document = mupdf.Document.openDocument(buffer, "application/pdf");
const page: Page = doc.loadPage(0);
const pixmap: Pixmap = page.toPixmap(
    mupdf.Matrix.identity,
    mupdf.ColorSpace.DeviceRGB,
    false,
    true
);
```

---

## How To Guide

### Working with Files

#### Loading a Local File (Node.js)

```js
import * as fs from "fs";
import mupdf from "mupdf";

const buffer = fs.readFileSync("input.pdf");
const doc = mupdf.Document.openDocument(buffer, "application/pdf");
```

#### Loading a Remote File (Browser/Node)

```js
async function loadRemoteFile(url) {
    let response = await fetch(url);
    if (!response.ok) {
        console.error(`Cannot fetch document: ${response.statusText}`);
        return;
    }
    let data = await response.arrayBuffer();
    let document = mupdf.PDFDocument.openDocument(data, url);
}
loadRemoteFile("https://mupdf.com/docs/mupdf_explored.pdf");
```

#### Saving a File

After obtaining a document instance, save with `saveToBuffer()`:

```js
const outputBuffer = doc.saveToBuffer("incremental");
fs.writeFileSync("output.pdf", outputBuffer);
```

### Working with Documents

#### Password-Protected Documents

```js
if (doc.needsPassword()) {
    doc.authenticatePassword("mypassword");
}
```

#### Document Metadata

```js
console.log(`Pages: ${doc.countPages()}`);
console.log(`Title: ${doc.getMetaData("info:Title")}`);
console.log(`Author: ${doc.getMetaData("info:Author")}`);
console.log(`Subject: ${doc.getMetaData("info:Subject")}`);
console.log(`Creator: ${doc.getMetaData("info:Creator")}`);
console.log(`Producer: ${doc.getMetaData("info:Producer")}`);
console.log(`CreationDate: ${doc.getMetaData("info:CreationDate")}`);
console.log(`Is PDF: ${doc.isPDF()}`);
```

#### Document Outline (Table of Contents)

```js
const outline = doc.loadOutline();
if (outline) {
    function printOutline(items, indent = 0) {
        for (const item of items) {
            console.log(" ".repeat(indent) + item.title);
            if (item.down) printOutline(item.down, indent + 2);
        }
    }
    printOutline(outline);
}
```

### Working with Pages

A page is a `PDFPage` class instance. Load it using:

```js
const page = doc.loadPage(0); // zero-indexed
```

#### Page Bounds

Returns `[ulx, uly, lrx, lry]`:

```js
const [x0, y0, x1, y1] = page.getBounds();
```

#### Rendering to an Image (Pixmap)

```js
const matrix = mupdf.Matrix.scale(2, 2); // 2x zoom = 144 DPI
const pixmap = page.toPixmap(
    matrix,
    mupdf.ColorSpace.DeviceRGB,
    false,  // no alpha
    true    // include annotations
);
const pngData = pixmap.asPNG();
fs.writeFileSync("page1.png", pngData);
```

#### Resolution / DPI

MuPDF's default resolution is 72 DPI. Scale factor = desired DPI / 72:

```js
const matrix150 = mupdf.Matrix.scale(150/72, 150/72); // 150 DPI
const matrix300 = mupdf.Matrix.scale(300/72, 300/72); // 300 DPI
```

#### Text Extraction

Plain text:

```js
const stext = page.toStructuredText();
const text = stext.asText();
```

Structured text as JSON:

```js
const json = page.toStructuredText("preserve-spans").asJSON();
```

Iterating blocks, lines:

```js
for (const block of stext.getBlocks()) {
    if (block.type === "text") {
        for (const line of block.lines) {
            console.log(`Line at y=${line.bbox[1]}: ${line.text}`);
        }
    }
}
```

#### Searching

```js
const hits = stext.search("search term");
console.log(`Found ${hits.length} matches`);
for (const quad of hits) {
    console.log(`Match at: ${quad}`);
}
```

### The MuPDF Coordinate System

- In PDF, the origin (0, 0) is at the **bottom-left** of the page.
- In MuPDF, the origin (0, 0) is at the **top-left** of the page.
- Coordinates are float numbers measured in **points** (1 point = 1/72 inch).

### Working with Annotations

#### Creating an Annotation

```js
const annot = page.createAnnotation("Text"); // or "Highlight", "FreeText", etc.
```

#### Deleting an Annotation

```js
page.deleteAnnotation(annot);
```

#### Listing All Annotations on a Document

```js
for (let i = 0; i < doc.countPages(); i++) {
    const page = doc.loadPage(i);
    const annotations = page.getAnnotations();
    for (const annot of annotations) {
        console.log(annot.getType());
    }
}
```

#### Supported Annotation Types

- **Text markup:** Highlight, Underline, StrikeOut, Squiggly
- **Text:** Text (sticky note), FreeText
- **Drawing:** Line, Square, Circle, Polygon, PolyLine, Ink
- **Other:** Stamp, FileAttachment, Redact

#### Highlight Annotation (from search results)

```js
const quads = stext.search("important text");
if (quads.length > 0) {
    const annot = page.createAnnotation("Highlight");
    annot.setQuadPoints(quads);
    annot.setColor([1, 1, 0]); // Yellow
    annot.update();
}
```

#### Text (Sticky Note) Annotation

```js
const annot = page.createAnnotation("Text");
annot.setRect([100, 100, 120, 120]);
annot.setContents("This is a note comment");
annot.setColor([1, 1, 0]);
annot.update();
```

#### FreeText (Text Box) Annotation

```js
const annot = page.createAnnotation("FreeText");
annot.setRect([100, 100, 300, 150]);
annot.setContents("This is editable text");
annot.setDefaultAppearance("Helv", 12, [0, 0, 0]); // Font, size, color
annot.update();
```

#### Redactions

```js
const redact = page.createAnnotation("Redact");
redact.setRect([100, 200, 300, 220]);
redact.update();
page.applyRedactions(); // PERMANENTLY removes content
const outputBuffer = pdfDoc.saveToBuffer("");
```

> **Warning:** `applyRedactions()` permanently removes content. The original data cannot be recovered.

#### Links

Create an external link:

```js
page.createLink([x, y, x + width, y + height], "https://mupdfjs.readthedocs.io");
```

Create an internal link:

```js
page.createLink([x, y, x + width, y + height], document.formatLinkURI({
    type: "Fit",
    page: 1 // zero-indexed
}));
```

Resolve an internal link:

```js
const dest = document.resolveLinkDestination(link);
```

#### File Attachment Annotations

Two ways to embed files:
1. Directly to the document (whole-document attachment)
2. As a FileAttachment annotation on a page

```js
// Embed file onto an annotation
const annot = page.createAnnotation("FileAttachment");
// Associate buffer of file data with the annotation
```

### Destroying Objects

For memory maintenance, always destroy JavaScript objects when no longer needed:

```js
pixmap.destroy();
page.destroy();
doc.destroy();
```

Pattern for safe cleanup in Node.js:

```js
const doc = mupdf.Document.openDocument(buffer, "application/pdf");
try {
    const page = doc.loadPage(0);
    try {
        const pixmap = page.toPixmap(/*...*/);
        try {
            const png = pixmap.asPNG();
        } finally {
            pixmap.destroy();
        }
    } finally {
        page.destroy();
    }
} finally {
    doc.destroy();
}
```

---

## Building Web Apps

### Browser — Rendering to HTML5 Canvas

```html
<canvas id="pdfCanvas"></canvas>
<script type="module">
import mupdf from "mupdf";

async function renderPdf(url) {
    const response = await fetch(url);
    const buffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
    const doc = mupdf.Document.openDocument(new Uint8Array(buffer), "application/pdf");
    const page = doc.loadPage(0);
    const [, , width, height] = page.getBounds();
    const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const matrix = mupdf.Matrix.scale(scale, scale);
    const pixmap = page.toPixmap(matrix, mupdf.ColorSpace.DeviceRGB, false, true);

    const canvas = document.getElementById("pdfCanvas");
    canvas.width = width * scale;
    canvas.height = height * scale;
    canvas.style.width = width + "px";
    canvas.style.height = height + "px";

    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    const imageData = new ImageData(
        new Uint8ClampedArray(pixmap.getPixels()),
        pixmap.getWidth(),
        pixmap.getHeight()
    );
    ctx.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0);

    pixmap.destroy();
    page.destroy();
    doc.destroy();
}
renderPdf("/sample.pdf");
</script>
```

### Browser — Handling User-Uploaded Files

```html
<input type="file" id="fileInput" accept=".pdf" />
<script type="module">
import mupdf from "mupdf";
document.getElementById("fileInput").addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const doc = mupdf.Document.openDocument(new Uint8Array(buffer), "application/pdf");
    console.log(`Loaded: ${file.name}, ${doc.countPages()} pages`);
});
</script>
```

### React Component Example

```jsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

export default function PdfViewer({ pdfUrl }) {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        async function renderPdf() {
            const mupdf = await import('mupdf');
            const response = await fetch(pdfUrl);
            const buffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
            const doc = mupdf.Document.openDocument(new Uint8Array(buffer), "application/pdf");
            const page = doc.loadPage(0);
            // ... render to canvasRef.current
            page.destroy();
            doc.destroy();
        }
        renderPdf();
    }, [pdfUrl]);

    return <canvas ref={canvasRef} />;
}
```

## Deprecated Modules

The `mupdf/tasks` and `mupdf/mupdfjs` sub-modules are deprecated and no longer available. Their functionality is now available as copyable example code.

### Migration from `andytango/mupdf-js`

```ts
// OLD (deprecated)
import { createMuPdf } from "mupdf-js";

// NEW (official)
import mupdf from "mupdf";
```

#### tasks.ts — Compatibility helpers

```ts
import * as mupdf from "mupdf"

export function loadPDF(data: Buffer | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array) {
    return new mupdf.PDFDocument(data)
}

export function drawPageAsPNG(document: mupdf.PDFDocument, pageNumber: number, dpi: number): Uint8Array {
    const page = document.loadPage(pageNumber)
    const zoom = dpi / 72
    return page.toPixmap([zoom, 0, 0, zoom, 0, 0], mupdf.ColorSpace.DeviceRGB).asPNG()
}

export function drawPageAsHTML(document: mupdf.PDFDocument, pageNumber: number, id: number): string {
    return document.loadPage(pageNumber).toStructuredText().asHTML(id)
}

export function drawPageAsSVG(document: mupdf.PDFDocument, pageNumber: number): string {
    const page = document.loadPage(pageNumber)
    const buffer = new mupdf.Buffer()
    const writer = new mupdf.DocumentWriter(buffer, "svg", "")
    const device = writer.beginPage(page.getBounds())
    page.run(device, mupdf.Matrix.identity)
    device.close()
    writer.endPage()
    return buffer.asString()
}

export function getPageText(document: mupdf.PDFDocument, pageNumber: number): string {
    return document.loadPage(pageNumber).toStructuredText().asText()
}

export function searchPageText(document: mupdf.PDFDocument, pageNumber: number, searchString: string, maxHits = 500) {
    return document.loadPage(pageNumber).toStructuredText().search(searchString, maxHits)
}
```

### Splitting a Document

```ts
import * as mupdf from "mupdf"

export function split(document: mupdf.PDFDocument, range: number[] | undefined) {
    let documents: mupdf.PDFDocument[] = [];
    if (range == undefined || range.length == 0) {
        for (let i = 0; i < document.countPages(); ++i) {
            let newDoc: mupdf.PDFDocument = new mupdf.PDFDocument()
            newDoc.graftPage(0, document, i);
            documents.push(newDoc);
        }
    } else {
        let ranges: number[][] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < range.length; ++i) {
            var a: number = range[i] as number;
            if (a < 0) throw new Error("Split error: document page indexes cannot be less than zero");
            var nextIndex: number = i + 1;
            var b: number = nextIndex > range.length - 1 ? document.countPages() : range[nextIndex] as number;
            var set: number[] = [];
            for (; a < b; ++a) set.push(a);
            ranges.push(set);
        }
        for (let n = 0; n < ranges.length; ++n) {
            let newDoc = new mupdf.PDFDocument()
            let graftMap = newDoc.newGraftMap()
            if (ranges[n] != undefined) {
                for (let o: number = 0; o < ranges[n]!.length; o++) {
                    graftMap.graftPage(o, document, ranges[n]![o]!);
                }
                documents.push(newDoc);
            }
        }
    }
    return documents
}
```

### Merging Documents

```ts
import * as mupdf from "mupdf"

export function merge(targetPDF, sourcePDF, fromPage = 0, toPage = -1, startAt = -1) {
    const sourcePageCount = sourcePDF.countPages()
    const targetPageCount = targetPDF.countPages()
    const graftMap = targetPDF.newGraftMap()
    fromPage = Math.max(0, Math.min(fromPage, sourcePageCount - 1))
    toPage = toPage < 0 ? sourcePageCount - 1 : Math.min(toPage, sourcePageCount - 1)
    startAt = startAt < 0 ? targetPageCount : Math.min(startAt, targetPageCount)
    for (let i = fromPage; i <= toPage; i++)
        copyPage(targetPDF, sourcePDF, i, startAt + (i - fromPage), graftMap)
}
```

### Scrubbing a Document (remove metadata, links, JS, etc.)

```ts
import * as mupdf from "mupdf"

export function scrub(document: mupdf.PDFDocument, options: {
    attachedFiles?: boolean, cleanPages?: boolean, embeddedFiles?: boolean,
    hiddenText?: boolean, javascript?: boolean, metadata?: boolean,
    redactions?: boolean, redactImages?: number, removeLinks?: boolean,
    resetFields?: boolean, resetResponses?: boolean, thumbnails?: boolean,
    xmlMetadata?: boolean,
}): void {
    // Clears metadata fields, removes links, JS, thumbnails, embedded files, etc.
    if (options.metadata) {
        document.setMetaData("info:Title", "")
        document.setMetaData("info:Author", "")
        // ... etc.
    }
    // Process each page for removeLinks, attachedFiles, cleanPages,
    // resetFields, resetResponses, thumbnails...
}
```

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is MuPDF.js?

MuPDF.js is the official JavaScript/TypeScript binding for MuPDF from Artifex Software. It's powered by WebAssembly (WASM). This enables browser-side PDF processing without server round-trips, Node.js server processing, and cross-platform use anywhere JavaScript runs.

### What can MuPDF.js do?

- Open, merge, split, rearrange, crop, rotate, and save PDF files
- Render pages to image format or HTML5 Canvas
- Extract text with position information and search across documents
- Create highlights, notes, drawings, redactions, and other annotations
- Modify existing annotations

### How does MuPDF.js compare to PDF.js?

**MuPDF.js advantages:** Fast, accurate rendering; full PDF editing; better font handling and text extraction.  
**PDF.js advantages:** Pure JavaScript (no WASM); Mozilla-backed; smaller bundle size; Apache 2.0 license.

Choose MuPDF.js for high-fidelity rendering, editing, or advanced text extraction. Choose PDF.js for simpler viewing where bundle size matters.

### What is the bundle size?

- JavaScript wrapper: ~50KB (minified)
- WebAssembly binary: ~8–12MB (compresses to ~3–4MB over the wire with gzip/brotli)

The WASM binary is loaded asynchronously and can be cached by browsers.

### Licensing

- **AGPL v3:** Free for open-source projects. Distributing software or providing network services using MuPDF.js requires releasing source code under AGPL.
- **Commercial License:** For proprietary applications or SaaS products. Contact Artifex: https://artifex.com/contact/mupdf-js
